name: Satlyt
description: 为卫星构建AI运行软件的平台,让多颗卫星共享大型计算任务,通过在轨AI决策降低数据传输成本并提高运营效率
description_en: Software platform enabling AI models to run on satellites, allowing multiple satellites to share computing workloads and reducing downlink costs through on-orbit decision-making
why_matters: 由前Google云计算和SpaceX工程师创立,已在两次演示任务中部署软件,通过在Momentus卫星上运行Google DeepMind的Gemma模型将传输数据量削减超过60%,每颗卫星每年可节省数十万美元
why_matters_en: Founded by former Google Cloud and SpaceX engineer, has already flown software on two demonstration missions, achieved 60%+ transmission size reduction using Google DeepMind's Gemma model on Momentus spacecraft, saving hundreds of thousands of dollars per satellite annually
latest_news: 获得800万美元种子轮融资,软件将于本周四搭载SpaceX火箭发射,与Google的Project Suncatcher原型一同进入轨道
latest_news_en: Raised $8M seed round, software launching Thursday on SpaceX rocket alongside Google's Project Suncatcher prototype
source_title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites

evidence.quote: The company has raised an $8 million seed round, Afullo exclusively told TechCrunch.
The Kenyan American engineer previously worked in Google's cloud computing business before a brief stint at SpaceX's Starlink communications network in 2024.

Earlier this year, Satlyt deployed Google DeepMind's Gemma AI model onboard a spacecraft operated by Momentus. The model cut the size of a transmission about onboard software errors by more than 60%, the kind of efficiency that Afullo says can save hundreds of thousands of dollars per satellite each year.

name: Legato
description: AI驱动的听力辅助眼镜，通过集成在镜框镜腿中的专利技术将人声与背景噪音分离并放大，适用于轻度至中度听力损失人群
description_en: AI-powered hearing glasses that distinguish voices from background noise and amplify speech while reducing unwanted sounds, designed for adults with up to moderate hearing loss
why_matters: 由前Bose高管创立，将听力辅助技术整合进日常眼镜形态，起售价999美元突破传统助听器的成本和社会认知障碍，已获1200万美元融资并正式上市销售，创始人曾主导Bose Frames和Meta Ray-Ban智能眼镜开发
why_matters_en: Founded by former Bose executives who led Bose Frames and Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses development, integrates hearing assistance into everyday eyewear starting at $999, addressing cost and stigma barriers of traditional hearing aids with $12M funding and commercial availability
latest_news: 2026年10月1日正式推出Legato Frames听力眼镜产品，可通过官网及美国部分眼科机构购买，支持视力保险覆盖
latest_news_en: Launched Legato Frames hearing glasses on October 1, 2026, available for purchase on website and through select U.S. eye care providers with vision insurance coverage
source_title: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses

evidence.quote: The official launch of the glasses comes a few weeks after the startup emerged from stealth with $12 million in funding from Neotribe Ventures, Listen, and Village Global.

Legato was founded in 2024 by Mehul Trivedi and Steve Romine, who bring deep experience in wearables and hearing care from Bose, where Trivedi led the creation of Bose Frames and Romine ran the hearing aids division.

Unlike traditional hearing aids, which often use directional microphones to focus on sounds coming from a particular direction and can struggle in noisy environments, Legato takes a different approach. Its AI-powered system distinguishes voices from background noise and amplifies voices while reducing unwanted sounds.

name: Peripheral Labs
description: 为体育市场构建空间智能技术，专注于实时体育的体积视频捕捉和无标记追踪基础设施，基于机器人技术和自动驾驶汽车感知的突破

Founded in 2024 by CEO Kelvin Cui and CTO Mustafa Khan, a pair of University of Toronto robotics graduates and former self-driving racecar builders
In May, Peripheral established what it claims was North America's first biomechanics basketball shooting lab outside of the NBA.

latest_news_en: Raised EUR 1.5 million pre-seed funding in October 2026 led by Syndicate One, one of the largest pre-seed rounds for a Belgian legal-tech startup to date
source_title: Law Firm Startup Falcon Raises Money To ‘Bury the Billable Hour’

evidence.quote: Falcon, a new AI-native law firm, announced today it has raised EUR 1.5 million in pre-seed funding, one of the largest pre-seed rounds closed by a Belgian legal-tech startup to date. The round was led by Syndicate One, with participation from Stelena Capital, Greenpark Investment Partners, RDY Ventures and France's Source Ventures.
Amaury, David, and Quinten spent six years building Mbrella, which they sold to D'Ieteren at the end of last year.

name: Tynapse
description: 企业级AI代理决策实时验证与控制平台,在AI行动执行前检验其判断是否符合企业政策与业务标准,提供决策信任基础设施(Decision Trust Infrastructure)
description_en: Enterprise AI agent decision verification and control platform that validates AI judgments against corporate policies and business standards in real-time before execution, providing Decision Trust Infrastructure
why_matters: 创立仅1年即入选NVIDIA Inception Grand Challenge 2026 APAC Top 10,提出超越传统身份与权限管理的新型AI控制层,验证AI'应该做'(SHOULD)而非仅'能做'(CAN),已在韩国金融机构(KB国民银行)完成实际部署验证并获金融委员长奖
why_matters_en: Selected as NVIDIA Inception Grand Challenge 2026 APAC Top 10 within one year of founding, proposes a new AI control layer beyond traditional identity and access management that verifies what AI 'SHOULD' do rather than just 'CAN' do, with proven deployment in Korean financial institutions (KB Kookmin Bank) winning Financial Services Commission Chairman's Award
latest_news: 2026年9月在新加坡举办的NVIDIA Inception Grand Challenge 2026亚太区决赛中入选最终Top 10,此前还获得NVIDIA GTC 2026 AWS创业竞赛全球Top 6和Snowflake Startup Challenge 2026亚洲Top 10
latest_news_en: Selected as final Top 10 at NVIDIA Inception Grand Challenge 2026 Asia-Pacific finals held in Singapore in September 2026, previously achieved global Top 6 at NVIDIA GTC 2026 AWS Startup Pitch Competition and Asia Top 10 at Snowflake Startup Challenge 2026
source_title: 티냅스, 창업 1년여 만에 ‘엔비디아 인셉션 챌린지 2026’ 톱10 선정 - ZDNet korea

website_verification.title: Tynapse | The Trust Layer for AI Agents

evidence.quote: 미래에셋벤처투자, 미래에셋캐피탈, 뮤렉스파트너스, 카카오벤처스 등으로부터 45억 원 규모의 시드 투자를 유치했다
AI 보안 스타트업 티냅스(Tynapse, 대표 강민승 )가 지난 22일 싱가포르에서 열린 '엔비디아 인셉션 그랜드 챌린지 2026(NVIDIA Inception Grand Challenge 2026)' 아시아·태평양 결선에서 최종 톱10에 선정됐다
티냅스가 제시한 해법은 AI의 판단과 실제 실행 사이에 별도의 검증 계층을 두는 것이다. 자체 개발한 '의사결정 신뢰 인프라(Decision Trust Infrastructure)'가 AI가 행동하기 직전 판단에 활용한 근거와 기업 정책, 업무 맥락, 위험도를 확인해 '이 행동을 해도 되는가'를 검증한다
2025년 설립한 티냅스는 창업 1년여 만에 '엔비디아 APAC 톱10'에 이름을 올렸다. 설립 초기부터 금융권 등 실제 엔터프라이즈 환경에서 AI 판단과 행동을 검증·통제하는 기술을 적용했다

name: OSCP
description: GPS信号が妨害または利用できない環境で自律走行車やロボットのナビゲーションを支援するフォトニックジャイロスコープと慣性計測ユニット(IMU)を開発する企業
description_en: Develops photonic gyroscopes and inertial measurement units (IMUs) to help autonomous vehicles and robots navigate when GPS signals are jammed, degraded, or unavailable
why_matters: 従来のMEMSとファイバー光ジャイロスコープの中間を狙い、FOG級の精度をマッチボックスサイズまで小型化し、より低価格で提供することで市場ギャップを埋める技術を開発している点
why_matters_en: Bridges the gap between cheap but inaccurate MEMS and expensive fiber-optic gyroscopes by shrinking FOG-level accuracy into matchbox-sized hardware at lower cost
latest_news: 2026年8月にNew Science Ventures主導で600万米ドル(約860万カナダドル)のシリーズA資金調達を完了し、既存製品の商業化と次世代製品開発を加速
latest_news_en: Closed $6 million USD Series A round led by New Science Ventures in August 2026 to commercialize existing products and develop next-generation offerings
source_title: OSCP closes $6-million USD Series A round to power navigation without GPS

evidence.quote: OSCP has closed $6 million USD ($8.6 million CAD) in Series A funding
OSCP was founded in 2015 by CEO Kazem Zandi, who holds a PhD in engineering physics from Polytechnique Montréal, has 15 patents in advanced microsystems and integrated photonics
We want to take a [FOG] and shrink that down onto a chip

name: Lottie
description: 面向英国社会护理行业的AI原生客户关系管理和账单支付平台,通过收购Found和CareMaster整合护理服务查询、入住管理、账单和信用控制等功能
description_en: AI-native CRM and billing platform for UK social care sector, integrating care enquiries, occupancy management, billing and credit control through acquisitions of Found and CareMaster
why_matters: 四年内将服务覆盖从不到100家护理机构扩展至近2500家英国护理服务点,预计到2027年上半年支持年度账单总额达30亿英镑,采用AI技术减少护理行业手动行政工作负担,在人员短缺和成本上升压力下提升效率
why_matters_en: Scaled from fewer than 100 care homes to nearly 2,500 UK care services in four years, expects to support £3 billion in annual invoicing by H1 2027, uses AI to reduce manual administrative burden in a sector facing staffing shortages and rising costs
latest_news: 2026年10月收购拥有25年历史的护理账单软件供应商CareMaster,这是其第二次护理软件收购,CareMaster服务近75家护理提供商、超过750个护理机构地点
latest_news_en: Acquired 25-year-old care billing software provider CareMaster in October 2026, its second care software acquisition; CareMaster works with nearly 75 care providers representing over 750 care home locations
source_title: Lottie snaps up CareMaster as AI push moves deeper into care operations

evidence.quote: when the company acquired Found in 2022, it was supporting fewer than 100 care home locations. By the end of 2026, it will support nearly 2,500 care services
Lottie has rebuilt the platform from the ground up as AI-native, expanded it into home care and supported living
